title: Resources / Introduction
slide_intent: Make approved materials easy to locate because finding the right source helps people represent a brand consistently.
strategic_value: A resource introduction and prominent shortcuts can reduce the effort needed to find Duolingo artwork.
demonstration: White introductory text and four quick links sit across a coral field.
practical_value: Separate the asset-entry point from detailed usage guidance when organizing a brand library.

content_islands.name: Introduction
content_islands.spec: Place the large lowercase heading above the explanatory paragraph at left.

content_islands.name: Quick links
content_islands.spec: Group Press Kit, Illustration Colors, Brand Colors and Duolingo.com in two columns at right.

reference_purposes.Intent: The introduction says these resources help people represent Duolingo or share its story.
reference_purposes.Application: The header routes readers to press, illustration and brand-color resources.
